ledger.why: TODO: a carrying or nursing parent must be born female; the engine reads only the sex field now (the role is the game's nursing parent, female), not a birth sex
the owner (2026-11-15): names instead of vague roles -- the person the role word names is a cast villager shown by name (flavour only: the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A family welcomes a newborn at a woodland gathering.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A family welcomes (parent)'s newborn at a woodland gathering.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Neighbors bring fruit and the family feels cherished.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The noise tires the parents, who choose a quieter celebration.

text_only.reason: a celebration talked about or planned in the story; nobody celebrates in the game -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Close relatives share a peaceful afternoon.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Friends feel left out until the family explains its need for rest.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The children perform a wonderfully uneven lullaby.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The baby sleeps through the entire performance.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The gathering combines traditions without ranking them.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The family postpones one custom until the baby is older.
